name: The Mighty Ken
source:
Eddie is a hot-tempered rat with a snappy tongue and a penchant for sarcasm.

Ken is a buck and their best friend who's the only thing keeping Eddie down to earth.

Eddie is moving in 10 days, Ken is not.

[From [url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/the-mighty-ken]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾迪是一只脾气暴躁的老鼠，舌头尖刻，喜欢讽刺。

肯是一只雄鹿，也是他们最好的朋友，他是唯一让艾迪脚踏实地的人。

艾迪10天后就要搬家，而肯则没有。

[来自[url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/the-mighty-ken]Itch.io[/url]]
